title: Chapter 421 - 421 Take A Shower In The Morning; Take Care Of Your Body!
content:
Chapter 421 - 421 Take A Shower In The Morning; Take Care Of Your Body!

Chapter 421 - 421 Take a Shower in the Morning; Take Care of Your Body!

421 Take a Shower in the Morning; Take Care of Your Body!

Lin Fan nodded at Xia Bing and Xia Xue.

Then, he took a stack of draft papers from Jiang Chaoqun.

Lin Fan flipped through it quickly. In just a few seconds, he came to a conclusion.

“You solved this problem well. Continue to work hard.”

Although it was just a simple compliment, it made Jiang Chaoqun extremely happy. He said, “Yes, Professor Lin!”

Seeing this…

Liu Qianqian’s and Nie Zhenjiang’s hearts tightened.

More people had solved the first problem.

They were behind!

At the thought of this, they began to work on solving the problems even more seriously.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue doubled their efforts.

They were not the ones who were the first to solve the first problem.

They absolutely had to snatch that title back for the second problem!

Everyone was competing with each other, and the atmosphere was extremely tense.

When school was about to end, Liu Qianqian came to Lin Fan with a stack of draft books and said, “Professor Lin, these are the steps to answer the first problem.”

Lin Fan flipped through it and nodded. “Good answer!”

Liu Qianqian heaved a sigh of relief.

Finally, she managed to solve a problem. She was not too far behind.

She heaved a sigh of relief, but Nie Zhenjiang was extremely nervous and flustered.

Everyone else had solved the first problem, and he was in last place!

At this moment, a crisp bell rang across Jiangbei University.

Lin Fan said, “Today’s class will end here. Everyone, go back and rest.”

After saying that, Lin Fan strode out.

Jiang Chaoqun and the others stretched their bodies, packed their books, and prepared to leave the office.

When they saw Nie Zhenjiang’s listless look, they immediately realized something.

They comforted him, saying, “Zhenjiang, you’re studying the Navier-Stokes equation. It’s normal for you to have difficulty solving it. After you go back, have a good sleep. Perhaps you’ll have a sudden stroke of inspiration and be able to solve it very soon. Take it slowly. Don’t be anxious.”

Nie Zhenjiang’s face turned red again at the mention of this matter.

The Navier-Stokes equation!

A few days ago, he said that this was something he was good at.

In the end, he had yet to solve the first problem.

“Alright,” Nie Zhenjiang said in a muffled voice.

After he returned to the dormitory, he did not have a good sleep.

Instead, he turned on the lights and studied the problem carefully, calculating for an entire night.

He was so anxious that he scratched his ears and cheeks, but there was still not much progress.

In order to prevent him from being listless in the office, Nie Zhenjiang took a cold shower early in the morning.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu, who stayed in the dormitory next door, walked over with a cat on his shoulder.

He looked at Nie Zhenjiang, who was still a little wet, and said thoughtfully, “Zhenjiang, you took a shower so early in the morning?”

“Yes.” Nie Zhenjiang nodded.

“Have you washed the clothes?” Hao Zhiwu asked again.

Nie Zhenjiang said, “Not yet.”

Hao Zhiwu could not help but take a step back and say earnestly, “The kidney is the treasure trove of humans and the pillar of a man’s life! Zhenjiang, you have to protect it well!”

After saying that, he even patted his shoulder gently, looking like he was taking care of him.

Nie Zhenjiang was baffled.

After a while, he seemed to have thought of something and spat out the words, “This guy!”

…

Although Nie Zhenjiang had taken a cold shower in the morning, he was still in a bad state of mind after not sleeping for the entire night.

He sat down in the office and felt drowsy.

At this moment, Lin Fan walked in with light steps

The cat, who was lying lazily on Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder with half-closed eyes, immediately opened its eyes and let out two crisp meows.

“Master is here!

“Master, did you bring delicious food?”

The cat jumped down from Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder and came to Lin Fan’s feet, rubbing against him.

Lin Fan smiled. “Don’t worry, the food will be here soon.”

As if to verify Lin Fan’s words, a delivery man walked over with a box and asked, “Is Mr. Lin here?”

“Yes, it’s me,” Lin Fan said.

“Please sign here,” the courier said.

After signing his name, Lin Fan opened the box. It was filled with yesterday’s premium cat food.

Seeing this…

Hao Zhiwu’s eyes widened.

The reason why he brought the cat, Lil White, over today was because he was a little worried.

On the one hand, it was because Lil White was constantly making trouble in the dormitory.

On the other hand, after Lil White ate Lin Fan’s premium beef cat food yesterday, it stopped eating cheap cat food that costs tens of yuan.

This made Hao Zhiwu furious.

He had no choice but to bring Lil White here today to try his luck.

What if Lin Fan brought premium beef cat food again?

That way, would Lil White not be able to eat a little more?

However, what was the situation in front of him?

The box was half the height of a person!

Yesterday, Hao Zhiwu went online to search for the price of this cat food. It was 1,589 yuan per 150 grams!

In other words, each gram cost ten yuan on average!

Even he could not afford to eat such expensive food, let alone to feed his cat.

How much did the box in front of him cost?

50,000?

100,000?

Hao Zhiwu felt his knees go weak and almost fell to his knees.

Lin Fan did not care that much. He casually tore open a bag of premium beef cat food.

The cat, Lil White, began to munch on the food happily.

“It’s so delicious!

“The new master is amazing!”

Lin Fan smiled. “If you like it, then eat more.”

Then, Hao Zhiwu, Liu Qianqian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others began to study hard today.

Although Nie Zhenjiang was eager to answer the first question and catch up with the others, he still had a lot of questions to answer.

However, he did not sleep last night and was in a terrible state. He seemed extremely tired.

Lin Fan seemed to have noticed this as well. After stroking Lil White for a while, he took out a box of Spirit Tea and said, “If you feel sleepy, you can make some tea for yourself.”

Nie Zhenjiang was too sleepy, so he had to put down his studies and get up to make tea.

When the boiling water was poured into the teapot with a few tea leaves, a rich tea fragrance instantly spread.

Nie Zhenjiang, who was originally extremely tired, felt refreshed as if a breeze had brushed past him.

Almost reflexively, he drank a large glass.

Instantly, it was as if he had a pair of wings, letting him soar wantonly under the blue sky.

All the tiredness from before was swept away, and what replaced it was extreme relaxation and comfort!

After a while, he came back to his senses.

Nie Zhenjiang stared at the cup of tea in front of him with a shocked expression.

When he raised his head and saw Lin Fan, he remembered what he was here for.

He was still in the office and had problems to solve.

Therefore, he quickly suppressed the surprise in his heart, turned around, and returned to the table to think about the problems again.
